name: Essential Cart Drawer
summary: Shopify slide-out cart drawer with in-cart upsells, a free-shipping reward bar, countdown timer, announcement bar and sticky add-to-cart bar; every plan has every feature, with plans tiered by monthly drawer orders.
best_for: Shopify stores that want a slide-out cart with upsells, a free-shipping goal and a sticky add-to-cart bar in one app, and prefer a bill that follows how many orders go through the drawer
skip_if: you want a different cart on every plan tier, you sell mostly through express checkouts that skip the drawer, you want a tool we have tested ourselves, or your theme already has a cart you like
honest_knock: The price follows drawer orders, so a store that sells well through the cart moves up the ladder, and eight paid steps make the bill harder to predict than one flat fee. Express checkouts that skip the drawer are not counted, so check how many of your orders use it. We have not installed the app, so theme fit and speed are unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essential 1 · per month for up to 99 drawer orders
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on essential-apps.com/cart-drawer/pricing, US dollars a month billed through Shopify) Nine plans with the same features, metered on orders that go through the cart drawer in a rolling 30 days. Free is $0 for up to 30 orders. Essential 1 is $8.99 for up to 99, Essential 2 $13.99 for up to 199, Essential 3 $23.99 for up to 499, Essential 4 $38.99 for up to 999, Essential 5 $58.99 for up to 1,999, Essential 6 $88.99 for up to 4,999, Essential 7 $138.99 for up to 9,999 and Unlimited $198.99 for 10,000 or more. The first paid plan has a 14-day free trial, once per store. Passing a limit moves you to the next plan automatically. We have not paid for a plan.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Essential Cart Drawer on a Shopify development store where all features are free: install, switching on the app embed and the cart drawer with a free shipping bar, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen and the cancel and uninstall FAQ. Nothing was paid, approved or uninstalled. Install: the App Store listing (English) said Free plan available. Free trial available. and Built for Shopify. The Install click opened the admin in a new tab; the first attempt broke because that tab was closed, and the second attempt worked. The install dialog (Install app) asked for access to customer data (device and activity data), staff data (store owner) and store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, Online Store, Shopify admin, other data). After Install the app opened without any payment at /apps/essential-cart-drawer/app with a Setup Guide at 0 / 4 completed and no plan choice first. Core action: step 1, Activate app embed in Shopify, opened the theme editor, where Essential Cart was switched on (the toast said Essential Cart activated) and the theme was saved, which is a real change to the theme of our development store. Step 2, Sticky Add to Cart, was skipped. Step 3, Enable at Cart Drawer, said Cart Drawer was successfully published in your store. and showed the status Live. Step 4: Customize, Spend tiers, template Free shipping bar, United States (Default) switched on and saved. The preview then showed a drawer with a timer (Checkout in 09:54), a rewards bar that said All Rewards unlocked!, two discount codes and a Secure checkout button. The Upsell menu item was On by default but no upsell product was visible in the preview. Timing, approximate tester observations: start at 10:43:30, saved at 10:47:00, so about 3.5 minutes and about 9 clicks (Install, Install confirmation, Activate, Save in the editor, Skip, Enable, Customize, Spend tiers, template, toggle, Save). The drawer was seen in the app preview only; it was not viewed on the shop itself because the store has a password page. Plans: the Plans page showed a Development store box (All features free: You are on a development store, every feature works without a subscription) and the Free plan, Up to 30 orders monthly, $0.00 per month, All features included, Automatically scales with your order volume, Cancel anytime, with a Choose this plan button that was not used because the app already worked. Show all plans lists Essential 1 up to 99 orders at $8.99 a month, Essential 2 up to 199 at $13.99, Essential 3 up to 499 at $23.99, Essential 4 up to 999 at $38.99, Essential 5 up to 1.999 at $58.99, Essential 6 up to 4.999 at $88.99, Essential 7 up to 9.999 at $138.99 and Unlimited 10,000+ at $198.99, each with a Start 14 day trial button. A 30 Day Money Back Guarantee - No questions asked! is shown. The App Store listing shows four plans (Free and Essential 1 to 3) and Above 499: 5 more plans, while the app shows all nine; the prices match. Checkout: Start 14 day trial at Essential 1 opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen with You will not be billed for this test charge., This app bills you for usage charges, an app spending limit of a maximum of $198,99 USD per 30 days and Add payment method (not filled in). The screen showed no price and no trial for Essential 1. Approve was not used, because the Free plan had already opened the app, and Cancel returned to Apps. Cancelling: the FAQ on the Plans page says that cancelling is done right on that page, takes effect immediately, drops the plan to Free-not-subscribed, unpublishes the cart drawer, stops further charges and keeps the settings. The FAQ on uninstalling says that uninstalling cancels the subscription automatically and that the drawer stops appearing immediately; reinstalling starts fresh on the current plans. There was no subscription, so no Cancel button was seen, the Uninstall dialog was not opened and nothing was removed. The FAQ does not mention a refund of unused days as app credit; it only mentions the 30 day money back guarantee. Not tested: upsell products (none visible in the preview), Sticky Add to Cart, the announcement bar, spend tiers with a gift or discount, the drawer on the real storefront, speed and theme compatibility, a paid plan, the limit of 30 orders, the automatic plan switch, the 80 percent email, the Founder plan and design changes by the user. Clean up: the app stays installed with the drawer live, the app embed on and saved in the theme, and the Free shipping bar spend tier on for the United States; no subscription was approved and all opened tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Saving the app embed in the theme is needed to go live, and no upsell product showed in the preview although Upsell is On by default.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.

Upsell products, Sticky Add to Cart, the announcement bar and spend tiers with a gift or discount.

Cancelling: the FAQ says cancelling is done on the Plans page and takes effect immediately, which also unpublishes the drawer. With no subscription we saw no Cancel button.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Essential Cart Drawer on a Shopify development store where all features are free: install, switching on the app embed and the cart drawer with a free shipping bar, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen and the cancel and uninstall FAQ. Nothing was paid, approved or uninstalled. Install: the App Store listing (English) said Free plan available. Free trial available. and Built for Shopify. The Install click opened the admin in a new tab; the first attempt broke because that tab was closed, and the second attempt worked. The install dialog (Install app) asked for access to customer data (device and activity data), staff data (store owner) and store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, Online Store, Shopify admin, other data). After Install the app opened without any payment at /apps/essential-cart-drawer/app with a Setup Guide at 0 / 4 completed and no plan choice first. Core action: step 1, Activate app embed in Shopify, opened the theme editor, where Essential Cart was switched on (the toast said Essential Cart activated) and the theme was saved, which is a real change to the theme of our development store. Step 2, Sticky Add to Cart, was skipped. Step 3, Enable at Cart Drawer, said Cart Drawer was successfully published in your store. and showed the status Live. Step 4: Customize, Spend tiers, template Free shipping bar, United States (Default) switched on and saved. The preview then showed a drawer with a timer (Checkout in 09:54), a rewards bar that said All Rewards unlocked!, two discount codes and a Secure checkout button. The Upsell menu item was On by default but no upsell product was visible in the preview. Timing, approximate tester observations: start at 10:43:30, saved at 10:47:00, so about 3.5 minutes and about 9 clicks (Install, Install confirmation, Activate, Save in the editor, Skip, Enable, Customize, Spend tiers, template, toggle, Save). The drawer was seen in the app preview only; it was not viewed on the shop itself because the store has a password page. Plans: the Plans page showed a Development store box (All features free: You are on a development store, every feature works without a subscription) and the Free plan, Up to 30 orders monthly, $0.00 per month, All features included, Automatically scales with your order volume, Cancel anytime, with a Choose this plan button that was not used because the app already worked. Show all plans lists Essential 1 up to 99 orders at $8.99 a month, Essential 2 up to 199 at $13.99, Essential 3 up to 499 at $23.99, Essential 4 up to 999 at $38.99, Essential 5 up to 1.999 at $58.99, Essential 6 up to 4.999 at $88.99, Essential 7 up to 9.999 at $138.99 and Unlimited 10,000+ at $198.99, each with a Start 14 day trial button. A 30 Day Money Back Guarantee - No questions asked! is shown. The App Store listing shows four plans (Free and Essential 1 to 3) and Above 499: 5 more plans, while the app shows all nine; the prices match. Checkout: Start 14 day trial at Essential 1 opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen with You will not be billed for this test charge., This app bills you for usage charges, an app spending limit of a maximum of $198,99 USD per 30 days and Add payment method (not filled in). The screen showed no price and no trial for Essential 1. Approve was not used, because the Free plan had already opened the app, and Cancel returned to Apps. Cancelling: the FAQ on the Plans page says that cancelling is done right on that page, takes effect immediately, drops the plan to Free-not-subscribed, unpublishes the cart drawer, stops further charges and keeps the settings. The FAQ on uninstalling says that uninstalling cancels the subscription automatically and that the drawer stops appearing immediately; reinstalling starts fresh on the current plans. There was no subscription, so no Cancel button was seen, the Uninstall dialog was not opened and nothing was removed. The FAQ does not mention a refund of unused days as app credit; it only mentions the 30 day money back guarantee. Not tested: upsell products (none visible in the preview), Sticky Add to Cart, the announcement bar, spend tiers with a gift or discount, the drawer on the real storefront, speed and theme compatibility, a paid plan, the limit of 30 orders, the automatic plan switch, the 80 percent email, the Founder plan and design changes by the user. Clean up: the app stays installed with the drawer live, the app embed on and saved in the theme, and the Free shipping bar spend tier on for the United States; no subscription was approved and all opened tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Saving the app embed in the theme is needed to go live, and no upsell product showed in the preview although Upsell is On by default.
